items.title: UK trading platform Hargreaves Lansdown ends its crypto holdout
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses how one of the UK's largest investment platforms, Hargreaves Lansdown, is now allowing retail investors to trade bitcoin (BTC-USD) and ether (ETH-USD) products after regulators lifted a ban last year. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto. Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: Bessent 'Wants To Win', Drive Yields Lower: Brill
items.summary: Matt Brill, head of North American investment grade credit at Invesco, and Meghan Robson, head of US credit strategy at BNP Paribas, joins Michael McKee on "Bloomberg Real Yield." They discuss Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's focus on driving yields lower.

items.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 We Keep Off Our Radar
items.summary: The $10-50 price range often includes mid-sized businesses with proven track records and plenty of growth runway ahead. They also usually carry less risk than penny stocks, though they’re not immune to volatility as many lack the scale advantages of their larger peers.
